name: Guangdong Dongfang Precision Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating both domestically in China and across global markets, Guangdong Dongfang Precision Science & Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the full lifecycle of corrugated packaging equipment, from initial research and design through to development, manufacturing, sales, and ongoing service. Its product portfolio includes advanced corrugator lines engineered for the efficient production of corrugated boards, alongside intelligent packaging machinery that transforms these boards into finished corrugated boxes. Additionally, the company provides an intelligent plant platform designed to empower clients with a digitized and networked equipment infrastructure, seamlessly integrating business operations, financial transactions, and information flow. The firm also manufactures outboard motors, which find diverse applications in areas such as water recreation, fishing, marine transportation, emergency services, shore-landing operations, and maritime surveillance. Established in 1996, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Foshan, People's Republic of China.
